title: Simulation Salary Registers — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A payslip from a simulation — a trial run that shows what payroll would pay without paying it. Simulation payslips are kept apart from real ones and are never locked.

fields.label: EmployeeId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from the employee list.
fields.html: What it is. The employee the payslip is for.

fields.label: ForPeriod
fields.html:
What it is. The month the pay is for.

Example. 2026-03-31

Why it matters. For a retro recalculation this is an earlier month than In Period.

fields.label: InPeriod
fields.html:
What it is. The month the pay is paid in — the run's pay date.

Example. 2026-04-30

fields.label: PayrollRunType
fields.rules: Required. One of: Regular, Off Cycle.
fields.html:
What it is. Whether the payslip came from a regular or an off-cycle run.

Example. Regular

fields.label: PayrollResultType
fields.rules: Required. One of: Current, Last, Archive.
fields.html:
What it is. Which result this is for its month.

Example. Current

Why it matters. A regular run writes Current. When the same month is recalculated in a later run, the older payslips for that month become Last (the most recent before) and Archive (the rest).

fields.label: PayrollReasonTypeId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Payroll Reason Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The off-cycle reason, for an off-cycle payslip.

Example. End Of Service

Why it matters. Blank on regular payslips.
